balls.text: yorker does the trick, pitched up just outside off and Pollock just drags it back onto leg stump as Zaheer keeps the damage minimal off the last ball
looks for the expansive pull but just slogs out to deep midwicket
yorker-length delivery outside off, good use of the split-fingers, Pollock makes room and can only drive a single into the covers
bang! Pollock pulls the short ball superbly over square leg for a one-bounce four, totally wrong line from Zaheer on that occasion
slower ball, there to hit but Pollock backs away a tad too much and cannot make contact with his attempted slash over extra cover
hits a good length and Harbhajan opens the face, pushing to gully
thats outta here! Pollock sizes up Praveen up and drills him handsomely over wide long-on for a big six, all power and placement
well held by Zaheer at fine leg, after Nayar pulls a short one on the stumps, just keeping his eyes on the ball and cupping it to his right, a spirited innings comes to an end
good slower ball on a length and again Pollock cant put it away, just chopping into the covers this time
bowls a superb bouncer which Pollock cannot get bat on, he seemed a tad surprised by that, then looks to square leg to inquire about the bounced wide but the umpire is unmoved
stands his ground and slashes to Chanderpaul at short third man
full in the zone, Pollock cannot hit the yorker very well and the ball dribbles into the covers as they cross to raise the 150 for Mumbai
shuffles down and across, whipping across the line to keep strike
oh thats bigger and better! Polly! He's enjoying his post-retirement cricket, just creating room and repeating the shot but this time for half a dozen
bang, thats four! Pollock makes room as well and drives flat over extra cover
another step to leg, another slog, this one ugly and into the covers
clean biff, just using his feet and going dead straight for six over the sightscreen! Not a bad ball at all, just some good old fashioned hitting
again he makes room to leg, and skies a short ball safely up and over the man at cover, the ball drops safely in no-man's-land
lucky start for Polly, driving and inside-edging down to fine leg

brilliantly stumped! Uthappa perishes attempting another of those cheeky scoops, walking down and across well before the ball is bowled, missing the line and Boucher pulls off an extremely neat piece of glovework, as its not easy standing up to a medium-pacer
makes room to leg and drills him straight down the ground, Akhil gets a finger on it to take some pace off the ball
connects well with his pull and just picks the gap over square leg
gets down and goes for a big slog, mistiming completely, Nayar calls for the inside-edge towards gully and they get it
steps outside leg, Akhil follows him and Nayar drives to mid-on
good shot, just scooping from middle and off to fine leg .. that makes it 43 from three overs from Kallis
makes room and slashes this one down to short third man, where Akhil allows the ball through his legs .. poor stuff, and he did the same against Kolkata
gets a short one and slogs it off the back foot, drops safely down at mid-on
gets back in his crease and he drives it down the ground, not timed well

madness, Uthappa walking well across his stumps before the ball is bowled, trying to scoop it away to leg but instead getting a leading-edge to Kohli at point, then the throw misses else he was a goner
makes room and cuts out to the man at deep backward point
walks down and drills him down to mid-off, where Chanderpaul dives
gets a full one and creams it on the up out to the deep cover sweeper
this time he makes contact, scooping it over Boucher to fine leg, where the fielder collects and fires in a throw to Boucher, who whips off the bails but Uthappa dives to make it back in time
attempts the paddle-pull but fails to make contact, Boucher collects well
good length ball, Nayar pushes to mid-off and they set off

dropped, but what an effort! Too straight and he picks it up off the hips, struck very hard and Vinay nearly pulls off a fantastic effort diving forward at deep midwicket, cupping it but doesn't hang on, but that was never going to be easy
back of a length, he gets back and pushes into the covers
sees the width and slaps it but gets an under-edge wide of Boucher
good length on middle and off, gently pushed back to Akhil
comes forward and pushes this one to point for a quick single
full and very wide, he reaches out and makes contact, but its a mistimed slog that spirals up and settles in Kohli's hands, stepping back at extra cover
back of a length outside off and he drives off the back foot to cover
good take, Boucher collecting the ball as Shah misses out on the slog from his crease, flicking off the bails with his back leg just inside the line
slogs again from off stump but the top-edge falls safely between two fielders converging in the deep, Shah is looking to dominate Joshi
again he exposes the stumps and steers this one to backward point
well bowled, the arm ball spitting up and just beating the face of the bat as Uthappa tries to cheeky dab, too close for comfort
strides forward and attempts the sweep, but paddles it onto his leg instead
reaches out and slogs again into the gap at midwicket, not pretty at all
spins flat outside off stump, Shah reaches out but cant get there
boof! Uthappa's shot that, just picking and playing on length and clubbing it flat  over midwicket for six, crowd appreciates it too
he's in control this time, judging the length and width and staying still to open the face and glide it down to third man, top shot
back of a length, lovely seam position, beats Uthappa as he feels for it
whoops, that one slips out and floats up outside off but he cannot make solid contact, instead slapping it out to Chanderpaul at deep point again
makes room and gets over a short one to slap it away past point, Chanderpaul does the covering up on the ropes
that takes off! Short one surprises Shah, simply flying through at a terrific height, Boucher does well to collect it
this time he attempts a reverse-sweep and misses
well bowled, well kept, and silly shot! Uthappa tries to play an ungainly sweep to an arm ball on off stump, and just manages to get back into his crease ... that was close
flatter one spins away and he nudges it to short third man
gets down and slogs from outside off stump, not timing it well but doing well to pick the gap at midwicket and the fast outfield does the rest
a hint of turn and Uthappa lunges forward, then plays it late to gully
flat arm ball on the stumps, Shah waits for turn and plays to point
change of pace, fuller length and he cannot flick it away past midwicket
comes down and heaves at it but misses as the ball lifts on him
slips in and catches him on the thigh as he tries to nudge it away, struck outside the line and the height was also a factor, Shah does well to scamper a leg-bye
beaten, as another one kicks off from that sweet spot and gets Shah fishing from his crease, the ball again narrowly missing out on the edge, top bowling this
similarly tight delivery but this time Uthappa rides it and drops it near point
good length, good seam movement, draws him onto the front foot and playing a drive but the ball skims away narrowly missing the edge
again Shah gets some width and opens the face, beating the gap at gully
slower ball, back of a length, patiently tapped to backward point for one
short ball on the stumps, Uthappa hooks well and beats fine leg
short again and Shah gets up to ride the bounce, steering to third man
short of a length outside off, Uthappa opens the face and runs it fine
comes down to try and flick it away but gets an inside-edge to cover
good line again, but Uthappa works it uppishly through midwicket
plays from the crease, and away from his body, edging wide of Boucher and down the man doing duty at third man
much better line and length and he can only defend it to cover, who's slow
again he's too straight and so Shah flicks in the air to square leg
a touch too straight and some deft work with the wrists allows Uthappa one past square leg and midwicket, well complimented by Shah's running
full on middle and leg, flicked to midwicket, who fields well
full and straight, on-driven to midwicket and he wants one, but wisely sent back
walks forward and across the stumps to tuck this one past short fine leg
good shot, just judging the length and clubbing it over midwicket
full onto the toes and he opens his account with a flick to midwicket
good length on off stump and he comes forward to push it down
starts off too straight and Uthappa tucks it down to fine leg, where Zaheer runs around and does well on the ropes
good length ball on the stumps, watchfully defended to cover
too full and straight and he flicks out to deep square leg

good hit! Change of pace, slants into him, tucked off the pads and calls for the run, urged by Uthappa, but the ball dribbles to Zaheer, who collects and hits the other end with a superb throw, catching Jayasuriya inches short of his crease ... though it must be said his bat was not fully outstretched .. but a brilliant  throw from the bowler
short of a length on middle and off, he gets up on one leg and tries to half-pull but gets into a tangle
the thump is here! Do not bowl to this man there! Zaheer overpitches and Jayasuriya accepts with a firm drive through the covers for four
tight line and length and Uthappa defends down the track, then calls for the risky single and he just survives as Chanderpaul dives and throws from cover
yowza! Jayasuriya! The over comes to an end with a beautiful club over long-on for half a dozen, hit so sweetly and with utmost precision
this one goes across him and he dabs it away to backward point
three in a row, this one a deft tuck off the pads into the gap, poor bowling and poorer field placing
good length on off stump and he comes forward to defend to cover
same result! This one's hit straighter and with firm control
good clean hit from Jayasuriya, seeing the ball in his arc and teeing off downtown for a bottom-handed smash, crowd loves it
poor start, pitching outside leg and its just skims down for a wide
top-class delivery to end the over, just hitting a length and going right across Uthappa, who does well to remove one hand off the bat, but the ball really square him off
good stuff, the ball sneaks in from leg stump and Uthappa tucks it off the pads, Praveen covers ground and cuts off the four at fine leg, well done

ouch! Zaheer drops in another short one on the stumps and Thornely goes to pull, mistiming it onto the grill and then his nose or cheek and he falls to the ground in pain ... those must hurt something bad ... attention on the field for Thornely ... looks like the ball snuck in through the grill ... off he goes and Uthappa comes out ... hope Thornely is okay .. that was ugly
a jaffa! Zaheer bends his back and gets the short one to spring up from nowhere, surprising Thornely as he does well to drop the hands, Boucher collects very high
back of a length but too straight, so he works a single to square leg
good ball there, on the money and Jayasuriya watchfully pats it back
invites the drive and Thornely obliges with no footwork, missing completely
that'll be wide as Praveen tries too hard and swings it down the pads
back of a length on off stump, very tidy, and Thornely defends to point
too straight and Jayasuriya nudges it to midwicket
back of a length and he pushes that to the man at point

well if youre gonna flash, flash hard! Jayasuriya goes for a slash outside off stump and edges very hard over the gap between slips and gully, the ball bounces and goes over the hoarding and hits a little girl in the crowd ... hope shes okay
good length ball, pitching on leg and moving away, and Jayasuriya pokes that to cover and point where two men converge to cut off any idea of a single
free runs on offer, Zaheer straying outside leg stump and Thornely just tucks it off the pads into the gap, leg-bye called by Harper
oh well held, Kohli! Ronchi drives into the air towards cover-point and Kohli plucks a superb catch diving away to his left and low to the ground, that was firmly struck but he did excellenty
pitches outside leg stump and catches him on the roll, Zaheer and the slips ask the question but umpire Harper shakes his head, was struck outside marginally
straighter one and Ronchi taps that away to the fielder
thats a better length, and some good zip has Ronchi hopping around
full outside off stump, into the blockhole and its jammed out to third man
good ball, nipping away off a length and Ronchi, initially thinking about pushing at it, leaves it be
gets some width and creams that over backward point, one bounce and four, which gets the crowd into a tizzy
that hits a length and seams away exaggeratedly, wide not called
better ball, hitting a good length and Ronchi defends to cover
top shot from the debutant, creaming it on the up through covers
thats a ripper, hitting the upright seam and sits up, kissing the flap of his pad, Praveen appeals but the umpire is unmoved
and there it is, as Akhil drives to mid-on, who parries the ball towards mid-off and Boucher crosses for the winning run
full toss swings into Akhil, who slogs and misses, then wants one off the pads but as Kulkarni and all swoop in Boucher says no
gets some room but chops the ball to the fielder, scores are level
and he's bowled a wide, very short outside off, nerves for Kulkarni
hits a length and Boucher tries to cut loose, but mistimes the shot to mid-off
flat on middle and off, driven with good use of the feet to cover
smartly done, shuffling and paddling past short fine leg for two
what a catch! Brilliant! Kallis kneels down and slogs Harbhajan and Nayar dives forward at deep midwicket to pluck his third, and by far best, take of the evening
flat again and this time he drives the other side of point ... five to win ...
flat and wide, Boucher makes room and slashes past backward point
well bowled, flat on middle and leg, worked to mid-on very coolly

good grief, he's smoked it! Thats the biggest we've seen tonight! Nehra pitches in the slot and Boucher sends the ball nearly out of the stadium, hitting the roof and falling back... 19 runs from the over
clinical hit! Boucher! Backs himself, clears the front leg, and heaves it over midwicket for four more, what placement
makes room and drills this along the ground to long-off
back of a length and he chops into the ground at midwicket for one
full outside off stump, driven through the covers out to the sweeper
bang, big hit! Kallis gets a full toss and hammers it into the sightscreen! At this stage of Mumbai's innings, Pollock took 20 off the over, mind you ...
well bowled, full and flat and Boucher just plays it back to him
steps down and drives down to Uthappa again
again he uses the feet and drives this down to long-on, where Uthappa covers ground well and returns a good throw to keep them to one
fired in full, Kallis drives to long-on, who fumbles momentarily
full toss, he reaches out and slaps it and Nehra at extra cover dives superbly to save what looked a certain boundary
massive! Boucher sashays down and clubs this dead straight, wow!
overpitched, Boucher hammers it down to long-off, where Nayar dives
now comes the fuller delivery, which Kallis tries to drive past cover but instead inside-edges to square leg
smart stuff, Pollock sees Kallis coming down and foxes Kallis with a slower legcutter that sits up and surprises him but the edge falls well before Ronchi
shorter one, Boucher's attempted slog-pull dribbles to point
steps away to leg, then comes back, and slams the ball over point
walks down the track, Pollock drops short, Kallis flicks to midwicket
flat again, Kallis uses his feet and jams it to Pollock at extra cover, who misses the nonstriker's stumps and allows an overthrow
fired in quick on off stump, a low full toss, pushed out to deep cover
fired in full and wide but Boucher makes room to cleverly slap it away past the gap at point, and it races away
low full toss, he can only punch it to deep mid-on for one
flat and drifting into middle stump, Boucher shuffles and clips one
flat on middle and leg, nicely swept out to deep backward square leg
slow and low full toss, turned out to Pollock at deep square leg
thats it, just back of a length and he can only steer it to backward point
another rubbish ball, the attempted split-fingered slower delivery slanting well down leg stump, Mumbai don't need this
back of a length, Boucher hops across and tucks it to point
easy catch, as the extra bounce gets Kohli in a tangle, pulling with his eyes taken off the ball, and all Ronchi has to do is run in a pace and take the top-edge
makes room and slams that one, rather ungainly, to the point fielder
terrible stuff, well down leg stump so another run to the scoreboard
a full toss first up, which Kallis drives to into the covers for a single
well played, moving outside off to clip Nayar off his pads for one more
another firm drive, on the up through cover, to get Kallis on strike
slower ball on a length outside off, steered to gully and Kallis says no
smart batting from Kohli, shuffling and working the straighter one into the gap between short fine leg and square leg, expertly done there
thats smashed, square-driven over backward point very, very hard
decent start, swinging it in from outside off stump, Kohli defends with a long stride in and so the umpire cannot uphold Nayar and Ronchi's appeal for the shout
too short and he rocks back and pulls out to deep midwicket
makes room and drives expansively over extra cover for six, well timed
variation, slow again, but flat on the stumps and he clips to leg
slow through the air, he uses his feet and on-drives to long-on
slower one, marginally wide and Kohli plays the flashy drive late to pick the gap between gully and short third man, well played
too short and Kallis crunches that out to the deep point fielder
touch flatter on the stumps, Kallis sweeps down to deep square leg
well bowled, tight on off stump and he can only turn it to midwicket
quicker one, slipped in short and he pulls into the ground at midwicket
thats the doosra, spinning away as Kohli lunges forward
gets down and sweeps from off stump to square leg for one
tossed up on middle and off, he plays it away to midwicket
gone! Taylor, after a good little camoe, throws it away with a shimmy down the track but mistimes the lofted drive down Nayar's throat at long-off
tossed up a touch on off, Kallis waits for turn and drives to point
sharp turn there, slower through the air, beats Kallis' drive
good shot, just paddling off the pads out to to the sweeper
short outside off and Taylor cuts that very well into the gap for four
slow, flat and wide, and Kallis reaches out to slap past point
full again and its driven down to long-on for a single

oh ho! Harbhajan ends the over with a wicket, tossing it up on middle and leg, luring Dravid into a tame chip back in the air, Harbhajan dives forward to his right in front of Taylor and cups it just off the turf before celebrating with vigorous Punjabi gusto, even as Dravid questions the validity of the take, slowly waiting and looking to square leg and walking off
full and flat again and Taylor flicks it for a single to midwicket
better, better, full and in the blockhole and Taylor digs it back to him
much quicker but down leg and thats a wide
wow, thats massive! Taylor gets down and slogs this with the turn for a dinger onto the roof, woof!
and what a start! Harbhajan errs in length and Taylor gets down to sweep this to deep backward square leg, where the fielder catches it and falls over
some width now, Dravid backs away and toe-ends it out to deep cover
flat on middle and off, Taylor flicks nicely to midwicket for one
flat on off stump, Dravid uses his feet and drives to midwicket
flat and wide, spins away invitingly, Taylor slashes and gets a thick outside-edge to where slip could have been
slips down leg and Dravid sweeps down to the man at fine leg
flat on off stump, Dravid uses his feet and drives to extra cover
works across the stumps and on-drives a single to end the over
uses his feet again but cannot drive this one away, good length
comes forward and pushes this one into the covers
there's a lovely stroke, just a walked-in straight-drive of the highest order, something you're used to seeing Dravid play on session two, day three, all class
good line, not allowing Dravid any room and he tucks it to midwicket
strays onto the pads and Taylor whips it down to deep backward square
immaculate line and all Dravid can do is defend it back to Pollock
drives to extra cover, though he wanted to go straighter with that shot
short and he tries to pull from outside off stump but gets it off the toe end of the bat to the man fielding at midwicket
back of a length again, he work this across the line to midwicket
gets over a shorter one a punches off the back foot to backward point
back of a length again and he drives a good-looking shot to extra cover

and he falls, flicking a straight one over square leg and the man on the boundary just stands where he is and accepts the slog, no doubt the pain in his knee contributed to that rash stroke, to hand Kulkarni his maiden wicket in IPL
stands and drills this one to the man at mid-off, who stops the rocket
very wide, Kulkarni spraying it a mile outside off stump

attempts another slog but loses a hand off the bat and the thick inside-edge pings him in knee ... he's in a spot of pain and falls to the floor ... given his crab-like stance he gets into such an uncomfortable position that when that kind of mishap happens, it can hurt
thats just a fraction too short and thumped hard over midwicket, clean as a whistle, this guy really does need more of the strike
this one stops on him but he on-drives comfortably for a quick single
overpitched on the pads and thats a pleasing clip through midwicket
back of a length again, Dravid shuffles across and turns it to midwicket
slow bouncer surprises Chanderpaul, who reaches up and pushes it down in front of square leg, well controlled too
tidy stuff again, Dravid plays it late and tips the ball to point for one more
slower one on middle and leg, Chanderpaul drives to mid-off for one
shuffles across and nudges this one to midwicket for a single
good stuff this, back of a length to cramp Dravid, who just taps it back
keeps strike with a single, nudged while on the hop into the gap at gully
good textbook off-drive, using his feet and reaching forward, pushing past two men and the ball runs away out to the ropes
makes room but inside-edges the booming drive to square leg, Chanderpaul tried to throw the bat at it and slam it over the covers
comes forward and nudges a single into the covers
better shot, a meaty back-foot punch as Nehra offers width to Dravid
good shout, but the fact that the ball pitches just around leg stump and was carrying high before Dravid misses out on the flick after shuffling across does it for umpire Harper
no maiden over, as Dravid comes forward and pushes the shorter ball to extra cover, but what a nagging over from Pollock
good length and Dravid, attempting an on-drive, just plays it back to Polly
gets up his toes and crunches it to backward point, who fields well
beaten by the incutter, just inching forward and feeling for it, well bowled
slips straighter but Dravid cannot work it away, Pollock rushes forward
good start, typical, short of a length on the stumps and Dravid pushes at it
again, too straight and this one's picked off the pads to deep square leg
on middle and leg and he picks it up over midwicket for a flat four
drives off the front foot and gets an inside-edge for a quick single
swing and a miss from Dravid, a wild slog to one outside off stump
tight line, but Chanderpaul picks it and steers past backward point
swings into Chanderpaul, who tries to flick and gets a leading-edge which falls in front of the man at point
